A note on practice

I'm interested in the gap between analytical rigour and the people who must act on its outputs — making complex systems legible to the humans inside them. My work spans wearables, sustainable systems, infrastructure economics, and educational play. Whichever scale, the question is the same: how do we make this easier to live with?

Foodji

A CO₂e transparency and rewards strategy for Foodji’s smart vending network, nudging 100,000 monthly consumers toward lower-carbon meals without restricting choice.

Waste Trade

An interactive data product that treats plastic waste as a form of currency, revealing which countries build real economic value from processing the world’s waste — and which remain dependent on others to do it for them.
